description: This file defines the StatusSupplierActor class, an Akka actor responsible for providing system status and health information in a microservices environment. It handles commands to retrieve static status information and health metrics, interfacing with health-checking actors and responding with appropriate status info.

classes.name: StatusSupplierActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that provides system's status and health information upon receiving specific commands.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns Props configuration for creating an instance of StatusSupplierActor with the specified root actor name.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic, including responding to status and health requests and logging unrecognized commands.
